# System Architecture Goals

## Core Architecture
- Next.js 16+ App Router
- React 19.2+ Server Components & Actions
- TypeScript 5.5+ Strict
- Tailwind CSS v4.x (OKLCH Color Space)

## Transformation Status
A complete architecture audit has been generated, identifying current routes and targeting them for content expansion (> 800 words) and interactive modules.
See `.jules/revolution-plan.json` and `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` for full details.
